title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 375 (Winding up of unregistered companies)

content.overview: Subject to the provisions of this Part, any unregistered company may be wound up under this Act, and all the provisions of this Act with respect to winding up shall apply to an unregistered company with the exceptions and additions mentioned in this Part. An unregistered company includes any partnership, association or company consisting of more than seven members at the time of presentation of the petition, not being a company registered under this Act or previous company law.
content.glance: Unregistered companies (partnerships/associations with >7 members not registered under company law) may be wound up under this Act with the adaptations in this Part.
